yt.title: Social Security at a $40k, $60k or $100k salary (2027 formula) #Shorts
yt.description:
2027 SSA formula, turning 62 in 2027, 35-year career, full retirement age 67: $40k ≈ $1,844, $60k ≈ $2,377, $100k ≈ $3,400 a month. Education, not financial advice.

Full video: https://youtu.be/EAPiFqFBugc

Sources: Social Security Administration, Office of the Chief Actuary — PIA formula bend points, national average wage index (2025: $72,800.33), contribution and benefit base ($192,300 in 2027); 2027 COLA Fact Sheet. Calculations: Nest Egg Atlas.
Music by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0.
Narration is AI-generated.
